requirements.title: A subscript triplet designates a regular sequence with optional endpoints and stride defaults
requirements.definition: A subscript triplet designates a regular sequence of zero or more subscript values. Its stride specifies the increment between values. The first subscript, second subscript, and stride may be omitted; omitted first and second subscripts are equivalent to the lower and upper bounds for the array dimension, and an omitted stride is equivalent to stride 1.

requirements.title: A subscript triplet stride is nonzero
requirements.definition: The stride in a subscript triplet shall not be zero. This is a value restriction separate from R924's scalar-integer syntax; no static diagnostic is invented for a stride whose value is known only at runtime.

requirements.title: Positive strides proceed upward through the largest value not greater than the second subscript
requirements.definition: When the stride is positive, the triplet sequence begins with the first subscript and proceeds by that positive increment to the largest generated integer not greater than the second subscript. The sequence is empty if the first subscript is greater than the second.

requirements.title: Negative strides proceed downward through the smallest value not less than the second subscript
requirements.definition: When the stride is negative, the triplet sequence begins with the first subscript and proceeds by that negative increment down to the smallest generated integer equal to or greater than the second subscript. The sequence is empty if the second subscript is greater than the first.
